seoTitle: Video Watermarker: Add a Logo or Text Overlay in Your Browser
metaDescription: Put a logo or text on every frame of a video. Choose position, size and opacity. Private, no upload.
intro: Overlays text or an image logo on every frame of a video. You set the corner, size, opacity and margin.
why:
A watermark discourages casual reuse and brands your clips. The overlay is drawn on each frame as the video is recorded, so it becomes part of the picture.

Nothing is uploaded. The file is decoded by your browser and re-encoded, so quality drops a little and the result is WebM (or MP4 where your browser can record it). It records in real time, so a 60 second clip takes about a minute and the tab must stay visible. A visible watermark can be cropped out, so it is a deterrent, not protection.
howTo: Type the watermark text or choose a logo image (the logo wins if both are set).

faq.q: Which image formats work for a logo?
faq.a: Any your browser can open: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG. Use a transparent PNG for best results.
